resolvedFindings.fix: Cycle 2 (parser differential eliminated): verifyZipEntries inflates every entry under a 20 MB per-entry cap (every part, not only word/document.xml) and 64 MB total, and repackZip re-packs exactly those verified entries into a canonical zip (STORE, fresh local headers + CD + EOCD, CRC-32, no ZIP64/extra/comments, CD order); mammoth only ever receives the repacked bytes. Defense in depth in readZipDirectory: cdOff+cdSize === eocd exactly, disk/CD-disk 0, entriesOnDisk === count, sentinels 0xffff/0xffffffff refused, 0x06064b50/0x07064b50 refused in the directory+tail region, names normalized (case-insensitive, leading ./ and /, // collapsed) for duplicate detection. Cycle 1 checks (hidden trailing entry, duplicate names) retained.

resolvedFindings.fix: Entry names decoded with a fatal UTF-8 TextDecoder (invalid UTF-8 refused, no U+FFFD growth); names refused when empty, > 255 bytes, containing control chars (< 0x20, 0x7f) or backslashes, '.'/'..'/empty segments, leading '/' or drive letters. repackZip asserts entry count <= 0xffff and maxEntries (2000), name byteLength <= 255 (<= 0xffff), sizes and total <= 0xffffffff. assertRepackMatches re-parses the repack with readZipDirectory and checks names, STORE, sizes, CD CRC and the CRC of the stored bytes before mammoth is called. Directory entries (trailing '/') are skipped consistently and refused if they carry content. Entry cap 2000 confirmed; 2000 tiny entries verify+repack+self-check well under 2 s.
